verdict.rationale: The workers-sdk repo describes a simulator for developing and testing Cloudflare Workers that is powered by workerd, and the Wrangler docs list commands for developing Workers alongside creating and deploying them. This covers local development and testing on a workerd-based runtime. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that workerd is the same runtime used in production, details on local emulation of bindings such as KV, D1 and Queues, and independent or hands-on confirmation of local/production parity.
